skills.grammarMd:
Ask **Hewa çawa ye?** — What is the weather like?

- *Hewa sar e.* It is cold. · *Hewa germ e.* It is warm.
- *Baran dibare.* It is raining (the rain falls). · *Berf dibare.* It is snowing.
- *Roj derdikeve.* The sun is coming out. · *Ba tê.* The wind is blowing.
- *Hewa ewrî ye.* It is cloudy.

The seasons: *bihar* spring · *havîn* summer · *payîz* autumn · *zivistan* winter. “In winter” is **di zivistanê de** or simply **zivistanê**: *Zivistanê berf gelek e.* In winter there is a lot of snow.

skills.grammarMd:
The future is the **subjunctive** with **ê** after the subject:

- *Ez ê biçim.* I will go. · *Em ê bibînin.* We will see.
- *Tu yê bêyî?* Will you come? (**yê** after a vowel)
- *Ew ê çay vexwe.* She will drink tea.

In writing you also see **dê**: *Ez dê sibe bêm.* I will come tomorrow.

Not: *Ez ê neçim.* I will not go. · *Ew ê nexwe.* He won’t eat.

Time words for the future: *sibe* tomorrow · *hefteya bê* next week · *sala bê* next year · *piştre* afterwards.

skills.grammarMd:
**dixwazim** (I want) is followed by a verb in the subjunctive:

- *Ez dixwazim biçim.* I want to go.
- *Tu dixwazî govendê bigirî?* Do you want to dance the govend?

To want **someone else** to do it, add **ku** and their subject:

- *Ez dixwazim ku tu bêyî.* I want you to come.
- *Xezal dixwaze ku Hamo serçopî be.* Xezal wants Hamo to lead the dance. (**be**: the subjunctive of “is”)

The same works with *divê* and *dikarim*, which you know, and with *hez dikim*: *Ez hez dikim stranan bibêjim.* I like singing songs.

skills.grammarMd:
Many Kurdish wishes end with **be**, the subjunctive of “is”: *may it be…*

- *Newroza we pîroz be!* Happy Newroz (to you all)! — answered with *Ya we jî pîroz be!*
- *Cejna te pîroz be!* Happy holiday!
- *Destê te sax be!* Bless your hands! (thanks for food or work)
- *Rojbûna te pîroz be!* Happy birthday!

On the day itself everyone speaks in the future: *Em ê agir vêxin. Ciwan ê di ser agir re baz bidin. Em ê govendê bigirin.* We will light the fire. The young will jump over it. We will dance.
